episodes.title: Un negocio bonito
episodes.summary: Professional thief and con man Chayo is struggling financially and must convince an old friend to plan a heist on Colombia's Bank of the Republic.

episodes.title: La titular
episodes.summary: Chayo and Molina recruit a team while finalizing details for the bank heist, facing multiple challenges that threaten their carefully constructed plan.

episodes.title: Manosucia
episodes.summary: As the thieves start executing the heist, an unexpected difficulty involving the bank's safe significantly delays their progress and tensions arise.

episodes.title: Escape de Valledupar
episodes.summary: Once the thieves leave the bank, Chayo, Molina and Mrs. K face obstacles in transporting such an enormous amount of money out of the city.

episodes.title: Billetes malditos
episodes.summary: When the Bank of the Republic and law enforcement team shows up to throw a wrench in the thieves' plans, everyone involved with the heist is endangered.

episodes.title: Todo el dinero del mundo
episodes.summary: With one betrayal, the dominoes start to fall for the thieves as investigators capture those responsible for the heist.
